body: Thanks @herrBez for the well-documented issue. On first read this seems related / same as #43262. If you agree we'll link these and close this one perhaps.
Hi @mattc58 thank you very much for the rapid feedback. I don't know how I missed the issue you linked (sorry!). I close the issue in favor of the issue you linked.
Don't be sorry for sure! I had actually just been going through the backlog of bugs and so it was fresh on my mind. If anything this will remind me to discuss this with others on the team.
